_format: Phase 23.0 harness config. Copy to /etc/homelab-harness/config.json (root:root 0644). listen.host must be loopback; harness.py refuses anything else in code (ADR-038 §2). audit_file null means $STATE_DIRECTORY/audit.jsonl, which is what the unit provides. helper_timeout_seconds (280) is deliberately above the helper instance's RuntimeMaxSec (270, brief §6.9) so the endpoint outlives the helper and reports the helper's failure, not its own. max_question_chars matches the helper's max_question_chars (500): the helper TRUNCATES silently past its own limit (helper.py handle_ask); the endpoint REFUSES with too_large instead, so keep the two equal when either changes.
